notes.title: Happy New Year -Photo Mode-
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859765/9bd7b059b69e098391fdf902e2ae316caef04e2b.png[/img]



Happy New Year!
from BIG BOYS STUDIO.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859765/eb95a1c20a771e5234a411215b9bc21d508f296a.png [/img]




Otokomizu release is just around corner! 
(March,1)
Our development is going smoothly.
This time I will introduce the newly implemented photo mode!
I made the New Year's card based on the screenshot taken with this function.
Everyone, please take a lot of photos with Fundoshi man by all means!


■ Photo mode
During the pause, go to Photo mode mode with hold LT.
(The pause window etc disappears while this mode)
While in photo mode you can move the camera with the right stick.
When right trigger is pulled during Photo mode, images are output to the same folder as save data.


Thank you for your attention!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33859765/9f7021af148371922a7ca9eb0fb6cdc9571ffad9.png [/img]


Oops!

The houses will explode if you do not erase fire quickly.
Take care!
